_comment: Local Turnkey signer settings. DISABLED by default. Credentials come only from env: TURNKEY_API_PUBLIC_KEY, TURNKEY_API_PRIVATE_KEY, TURNKEY_ORG_ID, TURNKEY_SIGN_WITH. per_trade and daily caps are enforced LOCALLY by tools/turnkey_signer.py; Turnkey policies (policies.json) enforce the per-transaction cap and program/destination allowlists server-side; Turnkey has no native daily/cumulative limit for signing.
